training.augmentation: Uniform bounded translation and scale 0.75 through at most 1.2; all labeled faces retained inside the frame
training.validation: Original validation frames plus frozen spatial variants using seed 43
training.selection: Highest validation localization F1, first tie wins

interpretation: Removing fixed-layout dependence recovered missed cards but worsened precision. Perfect matched-card recall is not perfect whole-frame recognition.
limitations: Development captures are correlated, draft-geometry examples from one session
Synthetic tests do not establish captured-table generalization
Light-surface control cannot handle dim card faces and is not a replacement for the neural model
No calibration, hero/board role confirmation, temporal integration or coaching activation
next_work: Train against realistic non-card controls and mine high-scoring negative regions, then re-evaluate precision and recall together
